blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Rains will continue to affect Palawan and parts of Visayas and Mindanao due to the intertropical convergence zone (ITCZ), according to the state weather bureau on Wednesday. It also said that fair weather would be seen over the rest of Luzon. In the 5 a.m. weather forecast of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration, weather specialist Chenel Dominguez said that the prevailing ITCZ was weak. The ITCZ is the convergence of winds from the northern and southern hemispheres.
